title: すっきり牌合わせ ～PAIR TILE～
tagline: 12牌のミニ盤面。連続消しで得点アップ、時間制限はお好みで。
genre: relaxed layered tile matching / mahjong solitaire
coreMechanic: Remove two identical original geometric-icon tiles when both have no tile above and at least one open left or right side; clear the layered board at your own pace; optional 12-tile mini and 60/180-second time attack with four-second combo scoring capped at x8

inputs.select: click / tap a tile; keyboard focus and Enter / Space select
inputs.assist: optional hint, undo one pair, solvable reshuffle, restart or next board

boards.construction: original compact layouts; reverse removal assignment retains a verified solution
boards.stuck: no game over; undo or solution-verified reshuffle of remaining tiles

practice: Optional isolated pair-selection lesson; no production run events, BEST, saved board or cleared-board statistics
bestStorage: Legacy bestPairs and clearedBoards remain normal 24/48 metrics; comboV1Best:{size}:{mode} and mobileV1Clears:{size}:{mode} isolate new scores/clear totals
jev: development-only Shadow Review on observed findings; no runtime API or automatic gate
humanReview: author subjective playtest and physical-device review pending; user explicitly authorized publication before author play
telemetry: Existing common events and specific_game_events with event tile_pair/hint/undo/reshuffle; event-level only; practice isolated; upload requires existing consent/environment/endpoint
